divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

fasta: GRCh37 chromosome 21, the GRCh37-hgvs corpus's reference.fa.gz decompressed, passed to both engines on every run
input: variants.vcf: fourteen hand-placed chromosome 21 records, the reference base read from the FASTA, each with the one-base span 47612517, the intron between the second and third exons of ENST00000594486, a reverse-strand protein-coding transcript whose whole cDNA is coding. Ensembl VEP reads an intron of at most 13 bases as a frameshift intron. One record for each of twelve symbolic alleles (<DEL>, <DEL:ME>, <CN0>, <DUP>, <DUP:TANDEM>, <CN2>, <INS>, <INS:ME>, <CNV:TR>, <CNV>, <INV>, <BND>), the <BND> record naming its mate through CHR2 and END2; a bracket breakend with the same mate, a base of the transcript's second exon; and a single breakend in dot notation. On that transcript every row carries coding_sequence_variant and none intron_variant, with feature_truncation for the three deletion alleles and the two breakends that name a mate and feature_elongation for the six gain and insertion alleles
generator: candidate records annotated with Ensembl VEP under the corpus flags (the container command above), then tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 116 --assembly GRCh37 --dataset structural=<reference>=<input> --k 100 --seed 1 --covers overlapbp-overlappc-sv --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--hgvs --fasta-name ../GRCh37-hgvs/reference.fa.gz --out tests/golden/116/GRCh37-frameshift-intron-structural; tools/vep-storable-to-json <cache> <json> 21; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus tests/golden/116/GRCh37-frameshift-intron-structural --perl-cache-dir <cache root> --no-stats; tools/vep-golden-corpus classify --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field HGVS_OFFSET --flag=--hgvs. The reference runs without statistics: with statistics kept, Ensembl VEP adds feature_truncation to the rows of a breakend that names no mate, here the single breakend (docs/divergences/defect-f.md, section 13.3)
